hypotheses.reasoning: order-service v1.12.0 started rolling out at 00:40:44 (#1080) and was ready at 00:41:14 (#1117). About a minute later, POST /checkout began throwing unhandled TypeErrors in the new code: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading region)' at order-formatter.ts:180, tagged [v1.12.0] (#1198, #1262, #1323). The api-gateway 500s that follow (#1264, #1321, #1631, #1706) are order-service returning 500, so they are the symptom, not the cause. The errors are partial (17%) because they only hit requests whose orders are missing the region field. Ruled out: the billing-reconciler checksum errors on 2019 archive partitions started before the deploy and have nothing to do with the checkout path. The single card processor connection reset at 00:27 (#127) happened once and was retried. flag-sync shows only routine syncs.

Another reading is that some orders have missing or corrupt address data and v1.12.0 just exposed it. The billing archive checksum violations also point to data problems, but they are old partitions, unrelated to checkout, and started before the 500s.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll order-service back to v1.11.8. Then fix order-formatter.ts:180 so it handles orders with no region (null-safe access or a default), and add a test for orders with missing address or region data before redeploying.
